text_block_list.text:
During our meeting, I noticed a 
transparent container sitting beside Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, these are honey-marinated lemons. 
They are effective for aiding fatigue 
recovery, so I prepared them. ...Would you 
care for some as well, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
*nibble*... Mmm... It's delicious. That 
sweet and sour flavor slowly spreads...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we ended up finishing it in one go, 
didn't we? ...I hope this helps soothe 
both the race fatigue and your tiredness, 
Trainer.

...More fatigue from the race seems to 
linger than expected. It might be best to 
review the schedule.
